name: Can Hometelligent Inc. install custom-sized doors?

mainEntity.name: Can Hometelligent Inc. install custom-sized doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Hometelligent Inc. can install custom-sized doors. Many older homes, particularly in areas like Piedmont or Albany, may have non-standard door openings that require custom-fabricated doors. While custom doors offer a perfect fit and unique design options, a practical tradeoff is the extended lead time for manufacturing compared to standard sizes, and potentially higher costs. However, a custom solution ensures optimal insulation, a seamless aesthetic, and avoids the need for extensive structural modifications to fit a standard door.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Hometelligent Inc. installs custom-sized doors, especially for non-standard openings in older homes. This ensures a perfect fit but may involve longer lead times and higher costs.
